RECOMMENDATION: DON'T RAISE IT
LIKELIHOOD: Not reliably estimable from the information provided

An all-women panel is not, by itself, evidence of sex discrimination. Assigning a percentage would invent precision.

Your longer experience is relevant, but a group-head role may also prioritize people management, business development and client relationships. The announcement doesn’t establish her full qualifications or how either candidate scored.

Follow up on your written request. Ask for the selection criteria, their weighting, and feedback on your assessment against them—not speculation about panel members’ motives.

If you uncover sex-based comments, inconsistent criteria or different treatment, raise those specific concerns. If you’re considering a formal challenge, check local deadlines promptly; waiting for feedback may not extend them.
